question: If cos x = (5)/(13), then what is the value of tan X + cot X ?
solution:
**Given:**

cos X = 5/13

**Concept Used:**

cos X = Base/Hypotenuse

tan X = Perpendicular/Base

cot X = Base/Perpendicular

Pythagoras Theorem

Hypotenuse² = Base² + Perpendicular²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc83a290cad0c449f33fd580c24205c137e3b1d3a0fbd2f91578b9c2e73bd67c.png]
